outcome: Incidence of unplanned pregnancies after UPMWA treatment
cohort: 169 women of childbearing age who underwent UPMWA therapy for symptomatic uterine fibroids
finding: This study suggests that women may conceive naturally after UPMWA treatment for uterine fibroids, but further prospective studies with larger samples are needed to evaluate the impact on fertility and pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Of the 3 women who continued their pregnancies after UPMWA treatment, all gave birth to healthy term infants via cesarean section.
